title: Niu 16s data
description: The slightly polluted source water was pretreated in an integrated vertical-flow constructed wetland microcosm combined with a down-flow CW and an up-flow CW in Haining Second Water Plant, Zhejiang, China. The objective of this research was to examine nitrogen removal and the dynamics of the bacterial community during wetland microcosms treating water for about 7 months under high loading rate. The results showed that the average total nitrogen removal rates varied in different periods and had similar changing trend with the ambient temperature. Illumina highthroughput sequencing of 16S rRNA genes used to profile the bacterial community structure and diversity revealed that the phyla Proteobacteria, Bacteroidetes and Verrucomicrobia had a dominant presence in all sampling time.
